name: TOTPGenerateUri
description: Generates an otpauth:// URI for TOTP, suitable for QR code generation with authenticator apps.
syntax: TOTPGenerateUri( string secret, string account, string issuer, [struct options] )

params.name: account
params.description: Account identifier, typically an email address

params.name: issuer
params.description: Issuer name, typically the application or service name

params.name: options
params.description: Optional struct: digits (default 6), period (default 30), algorithm (SHA1|SHA256|SHA512, default SHA1)
